topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, introduces the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation, and outlines the approach for the session.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Innate Immune Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular features of microbial and damage signals and the pattern recognition receptor systems that detect them to initiate inflammation.

topics.label: The Cellular Inflammatory Cascade and Its Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte trafficking to and from tissues and how unchecked inflammatory signaling can escalate to severe systemic pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, the processes that repair damaged tissue, and the physiological consequences of chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
